title: Peruvian Beef Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry dish made with beef, Peruvian spices, and citrus.

ingredients.name: Nimble Greens (such as spinach or kale)

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from skillet.
Add Peruvian Stir Fry Sauce to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add nimble greens and cook until wilted, about 1-2 minutes.
Return beef to the skillet and stir to combine with greens and sauce.
Squeeze citrus juice over the top and season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot over rice or noodles, garnished with additional citrus wedges if desired.
